note.zh-TW: 模板沒有存貨減少列；減少時以反號填在同一列並加註（T12）。
note.en: The template has no inventory decrease line; a decrease is entered on the same line with the opposite sign and a note (T12).

definition.zh-TW: 存貨增加表示花了錢買貨卻還沒賣出去，這筆支出沒有出現在損益表，所以要從稅前淨利減掉。
definition.en: A rise in inventories means cash was spent on goods not yet sold, which the income statement does not show, so the amount is deducted from profit before tax.
